FACT (tier-1, 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027, SEC XBRL): R&D $8,675M (FY2024) to $12,914M (FY2025) to $18,497M (FY2026), 8.6% of FY2026 revenue, funding an annual architecture cadence no competitor matches.

evidence: At $226.27 (2026-09-02) and 24,100M shares, market capitalisation is roughly $5,453B. Against H1 FY2027 annualised diluted EPS of $9.70 that is 23.3x - which does NOT require bull-case execution. It requires the current base to hold.
INFERENCE: the price is not the binding risk here, unlike most of the AI complex. A business compounding at 96% priced at 23x forward earnings embeds a substantial demand normalisation already.
counter_evidence: ADJUSTED FOR EARNINGS QUALITY THE MULTIPLE IS MEANINGFULLY HIGHER. Stripping the $23,707M H1 gain on investments and taxing the remainder at the actual 16.5% rate gives core net income of roughly $98.3B for H1, $196.6B annualised, or about $8.08 of core EPS - a 28.0x multiple rather than 23.3x. Roughly 17-20% of reported net income is investment revaluation, not operations.
Free cash flow yield is thin: H1 FY2027 free cash flow of $70.0B annualises to $140B, a 2.57% yield on $5,453B.

INFERENCE: the $279B supply commitment means the downside is not symmetric with the multiple. A demand pause converts a low-capex business into one carrying a supply obligation larger than three quarters of annualised revenue.
missing_data: Company revenue guidance beyond the current quarter
Cancellability terms on the supply commitments - the single most important unknown for the bear case

evidence: Permanent-loss risk is genuinely low: $228,984M of equity, no solvency path, and a business that remains profitable under any modelled scenario. Estimated probability of permanent impairment above 70% is 2-3% (subjective).

The bull case is specific rather than hand-waving: if accelerated computing becomes the default compute paradigm, revenue of $1.0-1.3T by FY2032 at 50% net margin is arithmetically reachable from a $356B annualised base.
counter_evidence: STRUCTURAL CAP, same as the Samsung case: at roughly $5.45T of market capitalisation a 10x outcome implies a $54T company. Modelled bull upside is +100% to +160% over five years. This fails the outlier-magnitude test in policy/investment-philosophy.md section 4.

The bear is unusually severe for a company of this quality: a demand pause with $279B of supply commitments and a $90.7B investment portfolio marking down simultaneously gives a modelled -56% to -68%.
missing_data: None material - this is an arithmetic constraint, not an evidence gap
